definitions.explanation: The act of beginning something; the point at which something starts.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{十時|じゅうじ}に{開始|かいし}します。
examples.english: The meeting will start at 10 o'clock.

examples.japanese: {販売|はんばい}{開始|かいし}は{来月|らいげつ}の{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: Sales are scheduled to begin next month.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}を{開始|かいし}する{前|まえ}に{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please confirm before starting the construction.

notes:
{開始|かいし} means start or beginning. It is commonly used in formal and business contexts.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Pattern: Xを{開始|かいし}する (to start X) - transitive use
- Pattern: Xが{開始|かいし}する (X starts) - less common

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開始|かいし}{時間|じかん} (start time)
- {開始|かいし}{日|び}/{開始|かいし}{日|にち} (start date)
- {販売|はんばい}{開始|かいし} (sales start)
- {営業|えいぎょう}{開始|かいし} (business opening)
- {サービス}{開始|かいし} (service launch)

ANTONYM:
- {終了|しゅうりょう} (end, conclusion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {始|はじ}まる/{始|はじ}める: more general, used in everyday speech
- {開始|かいし}する: more formal, used for events, services, operations
